name: James Smith
bioAdditions: Pelletreau's Blydenburgh sketch lists 'Catharine, married James Smith' among the children of Joseph Blydenburgh 2d (and so a sister of Joseph Blydenburgh, 1732-1833), matching this Hauppauge James Smith's wife Catherine. Not a Bull Smith, and Catherine is not a Bull Smith descendant either (second-wife Blydenburgh line).

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 485-486
sources.supports: Blydenburgh sketch: Catharine (daughter of Joseph 2d) m. James Smith
